excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content:
> Are CLs sending only configured terminal block hash?
The exchange must happen with configured settings on both sides. No real terminal block hash must be involved unless there is `TERMINAL_BLOCK_HASH` override has been activated.

excerpts.content: yesterday i was focused on the override fix, but after reading better what has been said, I guess we also need to update the TTD in the kiln baked config. Correct?

excerpts.content:
This bug was ours. Prysm nodes "forgot" to submit sync committee messages post-Bellatrix fork. 😅 
I just patched and updated all the Prysm nodes on Kiln. I also provided the docker image for Pari and others to fix as well
